description: Unit test class for EventSenderImpl, testing message sending behavior including acceptance, rejection, and durability within the org.eclipse.hono.client.impl package.

classes.name: EventSenderImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for EventSenderImpl, verifying behavior of sending messages under various conditions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test fixture with mocked Vertx, ProtonSender, ClientConfigProperties, and HonoConnection objects.

methods.name: testSendMessageWaitsForAcceptedOutcome
methods.description: Tests that sending a message waits for an 'Accepted' outcome before completing.

methods.name: testSendMessageFailsForRejectedOutcome
methods.description: Tests that sending a message fails when the peer responds with a 'Rejected' outcome.

methods.name: testSendAndWaitForOutcomeFailsOnLackOfCredit
methods.description: Verifies that sending fails immediately if sender has no available credit.

methods.name: testSendMarksMessageAsDurable
methods.description: Checks that messages are marked as durable when sent.

methods.name: testSendAndWaitForOutcomeMarksMessageAsDurable
methods.description: Ensures that messages sent with wait for outcome are marked as durable.
